dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 10, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Tigers Tame Phillies in Blowout, Yankees Edge Nationals**

In a lopsided affair, the Detroit Tigers routed the Philadelphia Phillies 10-2 behind a three-hit performance from Derek Hill, who hit his 16th home run of the season. Hill's 3-hit day was matched by Kevin McGonigle, who also collected 3 hits. Aaron Nola had a strong outing for the Phillies, striking out 8 in 5 innings, but it wasn't enough to prevent the Tigers' blowout victory.

The New York Yankees snapped a two-game skid with a 5-3 win over the Washington Nationals. James Wood's three-hit performance, including a home run, paced the Yankees' offense. Ryan Weathers pitched 5.1 strong innings for the Yankees, fanning 6 and allowing just 1 earned run.

The Los Angeles Angels edged the Minnesota Twins 4-3, with Vaughn Grissom hitting a go-ahead home run in the eighth inning. Grissom's two-hit performance was matched by Wade Meckler, who also collected 2 hits.

The St. Louis Cardinals edged the Atlanta Braves 2-1, with Jimmy Crooks hitting a walk-off home run in the ninth inning. Crooks' single home run was the difference-maker in a tight game.

The Toronto Blue Jays outlasted the San Diego Padres 5-3, with Kazuma Okamoto hitting a three-run home run to pace the Blue Jays' offense.
